notes.title: PATCH STRAND DEMO 0.1.1
notes.content:
UI

- Clicking on the title menu no longer triggers non-overlay buttons.
- Improved gamepad sensitivity.
- Mouse sensitivity now applies correctly in the Pin Puzzle game.

----------------------------------------------------
BUGS 

- The menu no longer remains locked after focusing on a text field.
- "Level Granted" voice line now plays as intended.
- Miranda's book is correctly translated when swapping languages.
- Inspectable items are now correctly parented in certain cases.

notes.title: TGAGWCAGA presents Strand!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45261234/d266647042cd5a54901da5fb750875009dd3904a.png[/img]

Hello space travelers!

We’re proud to announce that Strand has been selected to be part of The Game Awards for Games Who Can’t Afford the Game Awards (TGAGWCAGA) 2024 Showcase!

TGAGWCAGA is an initiative aimed at highlighting independent games that deserve more attention. The showcase is happening today at 12:00 PM ET! Go take a look!:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ic1oJ-5fS7E
https://www.youtube.com/@TGAGWCAGA


A reminder that the[b] playtest is open[/b] to everyone and available on the Steam page!

Exnilo Studio
